title: Programmatic CAD efficiency — text-to-cad demos are 10GB meshes from <3MB Python
summary: Jake argues programmatic CAD expresses complex geometry more efficiently: the text-to-cad repo ships about 10GB of demo models generated by under 3MB of Python scripts, citing a 12,000-line W16 engine as an example.
question_it_answers: Why is programmatic text-to-CAD more storage-efficient than exported mesh libraries?

claims.text: The text-to-cad repo contains about 10GB of demo models while the generating Python scripts total under 3MB.
claims.evidence: the text-to-cad repo has ~10GB of demo models, but the python scripts that generate them are < 3MB.
